variants.concept: Compare the kit’s grouped childproofing categories with sourcing products separately
variants.primary_text: Comparing corner protectors, socket guards and locks one by one? The Peach Bucket 6-in-1 Child Safety Kit brings edge/corner protectors, socket guards, cabinet/fridge locks and door guards together in one kit for Indian homes. It gives you one kit to consider across several childproofing needs, without assuming every home needs the same setup. Adult supervision remains necessary.
